info.name: Docusign Gets a list of the folders for the account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: include
params.description: Reserved for DocuSign.

params.name: start_position
params.description: Reserved for DocuSign.

params.name: template
params.description:
Specifies the items that are returned. Valid values are: 

* include - The folder list will return normal folders plus template folders. 
* only - Only the list of template folders are returned.

params.name: user_filter
params.description: Reserved for DocuSign.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of the folders for the account, including the folder hierarchy. You can specify whether to return just the template folder or template folder and normal folders by setting the `template` query string parameter.

info.name: Docusign Gets a list of the envelopes in the specified folder.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: folderId
params.description: The ID of the folder being accessed.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Only return items on or after this date. If no value is provided, the default search is the previous 30 days.

params.name: owner_email
params.description: The email of the folder owner.

params.name: owner_name
params.description: The name of the folder owner.

params.name: search_text
params.description: The search text used to search the items of the envelope. The search looks at recipient names and emails, envelope custom fields, sender name, and subject.

params.name: start_position
params.description: The position of the folder items to return. This is used for repeated calls, when the number of envelopes returned is too much for one return (calls return 100 envelopes at a time). The default value is 0.

params.name: status
params.description:
A comma-separated list of current envelope statuses to included in the response. Possible values are:

* completed
* created
* declined
* deleted
* delivered
* processing
* sent
* signed
* timedout
* voided

The `any` value is equivalent to any status.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Only return items up to this date. If no value is provided, the default search is to the current date.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of the envelopes in the specified folder. You can narrow the query by specifying search criteria in the query string parameters.

info.name: Docusign Moves an envelope from its current folder to the specified folder.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: folderId
params.description: The ID of the folder being accessed.

items.docs:
Moves an envelope from its current folder to the specified folder.

###### Note: You can use this endpoint to delete envelopes by specifying `recyclebin` in the `folderId` parameter of the endpoint. Placing an in process envelope (envelope status of `sent` or `delivered`) in the recycle bin voids the envelope. You can also use this endpoint to delete templates by specifying a template ID instead of an envelope ID in the 'envelopeIds' property and specifying `recyclebin` in the `folderId` paramet

info.name: Docusign Gets a list of envelopes in folders matching the specified criteria.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: searchFolderId
params.description: Specifies the envelope group that is searched by the request. These are logical groupings, not actual folder names. Valid values are: drafts, awaiting_my_signature, completed, out_for_signature.

params.name: all
params.description: Specifies that all envelopes that match the criteria are returned.

params.name: count
params.description: Specifies the number of records returned in the cache. The number must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Specifies the start of the date range to return. If no value is provided, the default search is the previous 30 days.

params.name: include_recipients
params.description: When set to **true**, the recipient information is returned in the response.

params.name: order
params.description: Specifies the order in which the list is returned. Valid values are: `asc` for ascending order, and `desc` for descending order.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Specifies the property used to sort the list. Valid values are: `action_required`, `created`, `completed`, `sent`, `signer_list`, `status`, or `subject`.

params.name: start_position
params.description: Specifies the the starting location in the result set of the items that are returned.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Specifies the end of the date range to return.

items.docs:
Retrieves a list of envelopes that match the criteria specified in the query.

If the user ID of the user making the call is the same as the user ID for any returned recipient, then the userId property is added to the returned information for those recipients.
